title: Ashbury Rewards Guidance on Crediting Missing Stays
content:
A completed stay that was not credited when its folio was settled may be credited later to the Ashbury Rewards account at the member's request. The desk credits a missing stay when every condition below is met, each read from the records before anything is posted.

## Conditions

1. **Claim window.** A missing stay is credited only if the request is made no later than the tier's missing stay claim window, in calendar days, after the guest checked out. Days are counted as whole calendar days from the actual check-out date, which is day zero; a request on the last day of the window is accepted. The actual check-out date on the reservation is the authority, not the date the member recalls.
2. **The member's own completed stay.** The stay must be a reservation whose status is checked out and whose guest profile is the member's own profile; a stay booked in another person's name is never credited to the member, even when the member paid for it.
3. **Enrolment.** The stay's check-out date must not be earlier than the enrolment date less the tier's retro-enrolment allowance in calendar days.
4. **Not yet credited.** A stay already credited is not credited again; the request is closed by pointing the member to the existing transactions.

## What is credited

The stay earns exactly what the Ashbury Rewards stay earning and night credit rules would have posted at check-out, including the plan and channel conditions, and is posted with today's date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, window of 180 days, allowance of 30 days)

| Actual check-out | Request date | Day count | Window met |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January 2026 | 9 July 2026 | 180 | Yes — the last day of the window |
| 10 January 2026 | 10 July 2026 | 181 | No |

| Enrolment date | Actual check-out | Check-out earlier than enrolment date less 30 days | Enrolment condition met |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2026 | 30 January 2026 | No (exactly 30 days before) | Yes |
| 1 March 2026 | 29 January 2026 | Yes | No |

## Points of judgement

- A stay held under the member's spouse's guest profile, paid on the member's card, fails condition 2.
- A reservation still in house, or cancelled, is not a stay whose status is checked out.
- Where the stay already carries its earning transactions, nothing is posted again.
